note: Mountains-v4: one unchanged MIT mountain kernel per crest node. Every continent crest (riven-continents.json skeleton) carries a chain of nodes spaced nodeSpacingInHalfLengths range half-lengths apart along it, each a plan aligned with the crest tangent from earlier intent at the node; a column takes the largest raise of the nodes within one half-length. The kernel's own fades (mountain intent, uplift, parent band, headroom) and per-column water preservation keep ranges continuous, so the shared site lane and the whole-footprint certificate are gone. TerrainMap caps raises with the major coastal envelope (shores-v4). Mountains-v5: plans are twice as wide (widthMultiplier 2: 1,024 x 2,252-block ellipses), and massif relief covers the whole crest band: four octaves of isotropic ridged noise (wavelength 640 halving, amplitudes .5/.25/.15/.1, coordinates warped up to 160 blocks) times reliefBlocks 80 and a crest mask 1 - exp(-1.5 crest), under the mountain ceiling (Y288), fading over 64 blocks to water. Kernel peaks combine with it by maximum.
